item.text: The core issue is that archived membership rows still resolve as actors, and acceptance treats any existing row as an already-satisfied invitation. I’m checking the write paths and shared repositories now so removal also clears assignments/leads and recipient eligibility stays consistent.

item.text: One important edge case is invitation reuse: the invitation must be consumed even if its acceptor already has an active membership, while restoring an archived membership must retain that row and its history. I’m tightening that path along with role/removal conflicts and validating assigned users before any writes.
